hero.label: Class MA Eligibility Checker
hero.heading: Class MA: Does Your Building Qualify?
hero.description: Four quick questions to screen your building against the main Class MA prior-approval tests. Around a minute.

outcomes.label: Likely eligible for Class MA.
outcomes.body: Your answers do not trigger any of the hard-fail conditions. A full feasibility confirms it against live planning data and runs the prior-approval tests in detail.

outcomes.label: Borderline. A feasibility removes the doubt.
outcomes.body: You have at least one unknown or borderline answer. Class MA might still work, but the prior-approval tests need real data, not assumptions. A feasibility runs them for you.

outcomes.label: Class MA is probably not the route.
outcomes.body: Something in your answers rules out Class MA permitted development. That does not mean the scheme is dead; full planning may still work. A feasibility tells you which route, if any, stacks up.

emailOffer.heading: Want the prior-approval checklist?
emailOffer.blurb: We will email you the prior-approval tests a Class MA application is judged on, and what evidence each one needs. Useful whichever way your answers landed.

disclaimer: This screener is a quick check, not a planning determination. A full feasibility is the final word.

closing.heading: The Tool Is A Hint.
closing.body: Get a real, design-led feasibility on the building in five days. Fixed fee, clear Go or No-Go.
